57203c7e.text:
It is encouraging to hear that the new magic that our lord provided has performed above expectations. If the venom is as effective as you claim, it will be a powerful tool for us to use in the conflict to come. I told you that there was much to be learned from the $r littering our mountain. Don't worry, I won't hold your initial skepticism against you.

Finish your business there and return to the summit with your samples. No need to cull the beasts. If they spread to neighboring areas, they will only sow chaos, confusion and fear. This will serve to further the Pact's goals, in the end.

Good work. The Wild King will surely be pleased with what you have accomplished.
57203c7e.title: Bloody Parchment

1361-accept.name: Krusk
1361-accept.text:
A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace.  Speak with him if you wish to volunteer.  He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.

And sharpen your weapons.  Desolace is a place torn by war.
1361-accept.title: Regthar Deathgate

515-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
515-progress.text:
So glad to see you back, $N.  I was growing so terribly bored here.  Not a single entertaining thing to do besides poison and disease Umpi and reanimate her. . .over and over and over again.

How went the trip to the Undercity?  Were you fortunate enough to slaughter any humans along the way?
515-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

517-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
517-progress.text:
Sometimes I get so bored out here in Tarren Mill I like to open up the formaldehyde jar and let the lovely aroma waft through the air.  Makes Umpi a little nervous though.

So were you able to get a keg from the Dwarves?  I swear if I have to stare at this deadly elixir without using it on someone for another day I am going to scream.
517-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

524-progress.name: Dusty Rug
524-progress.text: A musty smell emanates from the rug.
524-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

544-progress.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
544-progress.text: Did you find the thieves? And more importantly, did you find what they stole?
544-progress.title: Prison Break In

545-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
545-accept.text:
Before it mysteriously vanished, there was an enormous magical barrier around the newly-reconstructed city of Dalaran. I care not what caused such a magical marvel to fail, but I do care that the newly exposed outskirts of their city may hide valuable magical treasures. Vestiges of the ruins on which the new city is built. 

But the area is patrolled by the wizards and their elemental slaves.

So hunt them, and return when their numbers are sufficiently reduced.
545-accept.title: Dalaran Patrols

545-complete.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
545-complete.text:
Very good. Thank you, $N.

Now we are free to pay Dalaran a little visit.
545-complete.title: Dalaran Patrols

547-progress.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve my sword, $N?  High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
547-progress.title: Humbert's Sword

550-progress.name: Varimathras
550-progress.text: What brings a $c all the way to the Undercity from the battlefield?
550-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

556-progress.name: Keeper Bel'varil
556-progress.text: Do you have the Worn Stone Tokens, $N?  The Magus is eager to unlock their secrets.
556-progress.title: Stone Tokens

557-progress.name: Keeper Bel'varil
557-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Elementals are tough quarry, but I know you're up to the task.  Do you have those bracers of binding?
557-progress.title: Bracers of Binding

7321-progress.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
7321-progress.text: Any luck finding the ingredients?  I'll tell you, the alliance maggots are far too numerous in this area now... In my opinion, they have come far too close already...
7321-progress.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

92434-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
92434-accept.text:
Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.

Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
92434-accept.title: Blood in the Streets

92434-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92434-complete.text:
It is surely no coincidence the horde has taken an interest in my city during such a precarious time.

In fact, I was counting on it. I have a proposition for you.
92434-complete.title: Blood in the Streets

92434-progress.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92434-progress.text:
Stay your weapon, $r.

I think you will find that key won't be enough to get past my wards. You didn't truly think we would leave such a vulnerability open at a time like this, did you?
92434-progress.title: Blood in the Streets

93680-complete.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
93680-complete.text:
A sewer key? Well, thankfully I am not the one who will be using this.

But we have work to do before it's safe to use this.
93680-complete.title: Key to the City

93680-progress.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
93680-progress.text: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?
93680-progress.title: Key to the City

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel
